Design

Stylesheet

The look of Bonehead in one place: the logo, colours, pixel type, buttons, cards, characters and icons. Everything below is drawn live by the game's own art code.

Logo

The wordmark

BONE in cream, HEAD in goldVertical gradients, top-lit bevel, chunky 2-cell strokes on a 6×8 grid.
The O is the skullSquare sockets, red pupils looking inward, gapped teeth. Never swap it for another skull.
Plum 3D side, ink outlineAlways on a dark or magenta ground. The HUD uses the same art, scaled down.

In the HUD

Logo colours

Colour

Palette

One palette for the whole game (js/art/palette.js). Every sprite, panel and particle pulls from it. Tap a swatch to copy its hex.

Backgrounds

Each table sets the swirling background from a theme: two base colours and an accent.

Type

Pixel fonts

Two hand-drawn bitmap fonts (js/core/font.js). FONT for everything readable, at size 2 for titles; TINY for labels. Colour codes like ^g recolour text inline. These dev pages use Pixelify Sans and Atkinson Hyperlegible; the game itself never does.

Components

Buttons and badges

Chunky 3D pixel buttons with a lip (js/game/ui.js). Gold is the main action, red is danger, ink is secondary. The yellow CTA is for the one big action on a screen.

Characters

Portraits

44×44 pixel portraits with idle, blink and talk frames. More on the cast page.

Icons

Icons
